items.source: Returns all labels that constitutes this node.
items.translation: 返回构成此节点的所有标签。

items.source: Returns the primary label for this node.

items.source:
The annotation to configure the mapping from a node with a given set of labels to a
class and vice versa.
items.translation: 用于配置从具有给定标签集合的节点到类的映射，以及反向映射的注释。

items.source: the labels to identify a node with that is supposed to be mapped to the class annotated with @Node. The first label will be the primary label if primaryLabel() was not set explicitly.
items.translation: 用于标识应映射到带有 @Node 注解的类的节点标签。如果未显式设置 primaryLabel()，则第一个标签将作为主标签。

items.source: The explicit primary label to identify a node.
items.translation: 用于标识节点的主显式标签。
